# Generic ATIF conformance fixtures

These are EBO-authored public examples. They contain no copied trial text or
private native logs. Agent names are input data; the core has no producer rules.

The positive OpenClaw counterpart uses the standard document shape and counts
of the privately retained November 6 trial: 68 steps, 65 calls and 65 results,
with version 2026.11.1. Its messages and tool contents are invented fixture data.
The partial counterpart keeps a literal gap message and missing-call fields;
neither supplies a compaction event or a complete-attempt count.
Hermes exercises v1.2 without declared inference counts. Acme exercises a producer
that EBO has never supported. Raw public-bucket fixtures stay private because
their redistribution terms are unstated.
